title: Carousel: 3 Questions Before Every Funnel
description: An educational Instagram carousel that shares a working method instead of a promise.

thumbnail.alt: Carousel cover: '3 questions before every funnel' on dark green

objective: Show expertise through a useful method – content people save and share.
insight: Most funnels fail before the first line of copy: the decision they should lead to is unclear.
approach: Cover with a clear promise of value
One question per slide, one sentence of explanation
Alternating dark and light slides – the website's rhythm in the feed

ads.primaryText:
Before I write a single headline, I answer three questions.

ads.primaryText: If the answer has an “and” in it, you are building two funnels.
